CAMERA LOCK — HIGHEST PRIORITY

The source image is the absolute camera reference.

Copy the EXACT camera position, focal length, perspective, camera height, camera distance, lens, framing, crop, viewpoint, pitch, yaw, roll, tilt, in-plane rotation, scale and product position.

DO NOT:
- Rotate the jewelry.
- Change the viewing angle.
- Create a hero shot.
- Create a 3/4 angle.
- Stand the jewelry more upright.
- Change perspective.
- Change zoom.
- Change focal length.
- Recenter or reposition the product.
- Improve composition.
- Change the product pose.

Overlay the final render directly onto the source photograph so the silhouette and every edge align with the original. This is an image-to-image material replacement, NOT a redesign.

PRODUCT IDENTITY — SECOND HIGHEST PRIORITY

Keep the jewelry 100% identical.

Do not change:
- Design
- Geometry
- Proportions
- Stone count
- Stone size
- Stone placement
- Prong count
- Prong size
- Setting style
- Gallery
- Under-gallery
- Halo
- Shank width
- Band thickness
- Curves
- Surface details
- Engraving
- Relief
- Openings
- Metal thickness

No added stones.
No removed stones.
No larger center stone.
No thicker halo.
No redesign.

Metal colour must remain identical to the source. If the source is yellow gold, everything must remain yellow gold. Never introduce silver, rhodium or two-tone metal unless visible in the source.

RENDER QUALITY

Re-render the jewelry as a premium CAD-quality luxury CGI while preserving every physical detail.

Only improve:
- Metal polish
- Diamond realism
- Gemstone realism
- Lighting
- Sharpness
- Reflections

Gold should have rich champagne and amber reflections, never white, grey or washed-out highlights.

Gemstones must keep their exact original colour while gaining crisp facets, realistic depth, internal reflections and natural brilliance.

Every diamond, including tiny pavé stones, must remain the same size and position while showing individually resolved facets, strong sparkle, rainbow fire and sharp edge definition. Never merge pavé into a sparkle blob.

CABOCHONS

If the gemstone is opal, moonstone, pearl or any cabochon, reproduce the exact colour pattern from the source. Do not increase play-of-colour or convert cabochons into faceted stones.

LIGHTING

Bright all-white lightbox lighting.

Pure white (#FFFFFF) background.

Exactly ONE soft shadow falling to the lower-right.

No second shadow.
No left shadow.
No contact shadow.
No grey halo.
No gradient.
No floor texture.
No reflections on the background.

Only the shadow may be darker than white.

COMPOSITION

Keep the exact same framing and camera.

Never rotate or straighten the jewelry.

If padding is required, expand the canvas with pure white (#FFFFFF) only.

Maintain the original layout exactly.

Output square 1:1.

Ultra-sharp 8K.

NEGATIVE PROMPT

different angle, hero shot, 3/4 view, perspective change, camera movement, camera rotation, different focal length, different lens, zoom change, standing upright, repositioned product, recentered product, redesigned jewelry, added stones, removed stones, larger gemstone, thicker band, altered prongs, altered halo, altered proportions, cropped jewelry, missing parts, extra reflections, multiple shadows, grey background, gradient background, textured background
